label: Town of Groton
header:
# Town of Groton municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 10; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Groton 2025 Town Report, published at the town's reports page (grotonvt.com/town-reports): the ELECTED OFFICERS table seats Larry Daniels (Chair) to 2027 and Mike Nahmias to 2028; Tom Page's term expired in 2026 and no successor is published, so the third seat is unfilled. (A companion roster that seats Dawn Evans on this board is not followed: in the town's own table Evans is an appointed planning commissioner and an elected library trustee.)

Town of Groton 2025 Town Report, published at the town's reports page (grotonvt.com/town-reports): the elected table seats Wayne Dyer as Moderator on a one-year term that expired in 2026. Structure only: no successor is published.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Carrie Peters as Groton town clerk.

Town of Groton 2025 Town Report, published at the town's reports page (grotonvt.com/town-reports): the town's officers table and contact page seat Carrie Peters as Town Clerk on a term that expired in 2026. Structure only: the town publishes no outcome for the seat. Peters is minted below as a justice of the peace on the SOS listing.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Lisa Hart as Groton town treasurer.
Town of Groton 2025 Town Report, published at the town's reports page (grotonvt.com/town-reports): the elected table seats Lisa Hart as Town Treasurer to 2027.
Town of Groton 2025 Town Report, published at the town's reports page (grotonvt.com/town-reports): the elected table seats Harold Hatch as Road Commissioner to 2027.

Town of Groton 2025 Town Report, published at the town's reports page (grotonvt.com/town-reports): the elected table seats Dan Webster as Town Constable on a one-year term that expired in 2026. Structure only.

Town of Groton 2025 Town Report, published at the town's reports page (grotonvt.com/town-reports): the elected table seats Dawn Evans to 2028, Jennifer Gaiss to 2027, Donna Russo-Savage to 2027, and Wayne Knott to 2028; Deborah Jurist's term expired in 2026 and that seat is unfilled.

Town of Groton 2025 Town Report, published at the town's reports page (grotonvt.com/town-reports): the elected table seats Brent Smith to 2028 and Susan Plant to 2027 (the contact page's 'Sue Plant'); Steven Batchelder's term expired in 2026 and that seat is unfilled.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven justices of the peace for Groton.

Town of Groton 2025 Town Report, published at the town's reports page (grotonvt.com/town-reports): the report's Board of Civil Authority block names the same seven (printing the second as Tirone 'Toni' Dyer; the SOS listing's Toni Dyer is used).
